text: REJECT: `ParentOrNull` returns null at the filesystem root, but the call site just does `dir = ParentOrNull(dir);` with no null check or loop-exit. The old `break` is gone, so the next iteration would probe with a null `dir`, which changes behaviour or throws. Assigning a `string?` to a non-nullable `dir` would also likely trigger a nullable warning that fails the build under warnings-as-errors.
